label: Table
description: A table you keep by hand, such as a budget, a reading log or a list of contacts, with the columns you choose.

columns.description: The table's columns, by name. A column has a `type` and may have a `label`, `description`, `required`, `enum_values`, `format`, `maxLength`, `minimum`, `maximum`, `type_constraints`, `adds_up` and `searchable`, as a column a type declares does.
